test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.**

The investigation conducting by the research team / yielded statistically significant results / providing substantial evidence / to support the hypothesis.

options.text: The investigation conducting by the research team

solution:
The correct answer is: "**The investigation conducting by the research team**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error is in the use of the present participle "**conducting**" instead of the past form "**conducted**".
 
• "**Conducting**" is the present participle of the verb "**conduct**."
 
• Present participles are used in continuous verb forms, such as "is conducting."
 
• "**Conducted**" is the past participle of the verb "**conduct**."
 
• In this context, "**conducted**" is the appropriate form because it is used with the auxiliary verb "**is**" in passive voice construction ("**is conducted**").
 
• Passive voice is often used when the focus is on the action itself rather than the doer of the action.
 
• The investigation is the focus here, and "conducted" is the correct past participle to convey this.
 
• **The correct sentence should be** "*The investigation conducted by the research team yielded statistically significant results, providing substantial evidence to support the hypothesis.*"

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
